user.title: Bentel Absoluta
user.description: Connect to the Absoluta panel through the ABS-IP plug-in (ITv2 protocol over TCP). The ITv2 session is closed by the panel whenever BOSS or the mobile app connects; the integration reconnects automatically.

data_description.host: IP address of the ABS-IP plug-in
data_description.pin: PIN of a Master, Normal or Limited user (1-6 digits). Only the partitions, zones and outputs of this user are exposed.

reauth_confirm.title: Update the user PIN
reauth_confirm.description: The panel rejected the stored PIN. Enter a valid user PIN.

error.cannot_connect: TCP connection to the ABS-IP failed. Check IP address and port, and that the host is reachable from Home Assistant. Detail: {error_detail}
error.invalid_pin: The PIN must be 1 to 6 digits.
error.handshake_failed: The ABS-IP accepted the TCP connection but the ITv2 session did not start. Check that ITv2 is enabled with encryption disabled and that no other ITv2 client (BOSS, app, another bridge) is connected. Detail: {error_detail}

data.require_code: Require the code to arm/disarm from Home Assistant
data.arm_modes: Arm modes offered on each partition

data_description.poll_interval: Zone open/closed state is not pushed by the panel and is polled at this interval (it also works as keep-alive).
data_description.require_code: When enabled the alarm panel entities ask for the user PIN, and the arming-mode buttons and zone bypass switches are not created.
data_description.arm_modes: Absoluta partitions are normally just armed or disarmed (Away). Enable Home (stay) and Night (instant stay) only if you use them on the panel.

error.no_arm_mode: Select at least one arm mode.

arm_failed_open_zones.message: Arming refused by the panel: open zones: {zones}. Close them or bypass them and try again.

arm_failed.message: Arming refused by the panel (blocking condition such as a mains, battery or tamper fault). Check the panel troubles.

options.night: Night – instant stay (partial, no entry delay)
options.forced: Forced – full arming even with open zones (they are bypassed). Shown as "custom bypass".
